verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers extensive memory creation, editing, auditing (/doctor), and consolidation (/remember, /init, dreaming) but never documents an explicit delete/erase memory command, API, or per-entity/full-wipe capability for privacy compliance. The one related command, /clear, explicitly 'resets the message buffer but keeps learned context' (letta-comm-5), meaning conversation clearing does not erase underlying memory — the opposite of the requested erasure guarantee.
